note: Bootstrap Paragraphs is a config-and-Twig package: no src/, no services, no plugins, no routes, no permissions, no Drush, no config schema, configure=null. It ships 167 YAML files in config/optional/ that install ~15 paragraphs_type bundles (bp_simple, bp_image, bp_blank, bp_block, bp_view, bp_columns, bp_columns_two_uneven, bp_columns_three_uneven, bp_column_wrapper, bp_carousel, bp_accordion, bp_accordion_section, bp_tabs, bp_tab_section, bp_modal) plus the shared style fields bp_background / bp_width / bp_margin / bp_padding / bp_header, and Twig templates that turn those stored CSS-class values into Bootstrap 5 wrapper classes. The stored value of a style field IS the CSS class (e.g. bp_width = 'paragraph--width--narrow', bp_margin = 'mt-5 mb-5'), and the view display renders them with the list_key formatter so the template reads the raw value; hook_preprocess_paragraph() rewrites a bp_background value into bs.background_color (e.g. bg-primary). All medium/hard cases are grounded in that real config and in real allowed_values read from config/optional/field.storage.paragraph.*.yml. Every artifact created by these scripts is namespaced field_bp_eval_* / field_bp_task_* / field_bp_hard_* / field_bp_uneven_* on the existing article node type, or a node titled 'BP Eval …' / 'BP Hard …' — the module's own bp_* bundles and fields are never modified.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal contrib module Bootstrap Paragraphs, almost every paragraph bundle shares a set of styling fields for width, margin, padding and background colour. Name those fields and explain what is actually stored in a width field — the human label or something else? Give an example value.
evals.expected_output: The shared style fields are bp_background, bp_width, bp_margin and bp_padding (plus bp_header for the title). They are list_string fields whose stored VALUE is the CSS class itself, not the label — e.g. bp_width stores paragraph--width--tiny|narrow|medium|wide|full, bp_margin stores 'mt-1 mb-1' / 'mt-3 mb-3' / 'mt-5 mb-5' / 'mt-1' / 'mb-5' etc., bp_padding the pt-*/pb-* equivalents, and bp_background values like 'paragraph--color paragraph--color--primary'. The view display renders them with the list_key formatter so the Twig template can read the raw class string.

evals.prompt: A Bootstrap Paragraphs paragraph has its bp_background field set to 'paragraph--color paragraph--color--primary'. What CSS class ends up on the rendered paragraph wrapper div, and which piece of the module's code performs that transformation? What Twig variable exposes it?
evals.expected_output: bootstrap_paragraphs_preprocess_paragraph() (hook_preprocess_paragraph) does a str_replace of 'paragraph--color paragraph--color--' with 'bg-', so the stored value becomes the Bootstrap 5 utility class bg-primary. It is exposed to Twig as bs.background_color and the templates merge it into the wrapper div's classes alongside paragraph--type--*, the bp_width value, and the bp_margin/bp_padding markup.

evals.prompt: I am adding an entity_reference_revisions Paragraphs field to a content type on a Drupal site running Bootstrap Paragraphs, and I need to pick which bp_* bundles to allow. Which of the module's bundles are meant to be used only INSIDE another bundle rather than offered at the top level, and what are their parent bundles?
evals.expected_output: bp_accordion_section (Accordion Section) and bp_tab_section (Tab Section) are child-only bundles. bp_accordion's bp_accordion_section field has target_bundles restricted to just bp_accordion_section, and bp_tabs' bp_tab_section field to just bp_tab_section. The README says to check every bundle except Accordion Section and Tab Section when configuring a node-level paragraphs field. They also carry no shared style fields.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has a Paragraphs field named field_bp_eval_allowed on the Article content type, restricted to a small subset of the Bootstrap Paragraphs bundles. Inspect the live site configuration and list exactly which paragraph bundles an editor is allowed to add in that field.
evals.expected_output: The allow-list is bp_columns_three_uneven (Columns (Three Uneven)) and bp_modal (Modal) — readable from field.field.node.article.field_bp_eval_allowed at settings.handler_settings.target_bundles.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is an Article node titled 'BP Eval Styled Page' containing a single Bootstrap Paragraphs section. Inspect the live site and report the exact stored value of that paragraph's background field (bp_background).
evals.expected_output: The bp_simple paragraph referenced from the node's field_bp_eval_styled stores bp_background = 'paragraph--color paragraph--color--rgba-teal-strong' (the 'Teal strong' option). Its bp_width is paragraph--width--medium and bp_margin is 'mt-5 mb-5'.

evals.prompt: An Article node titled 'BP Eval Carousel Page' on this Drupal site uses a Bootstrap Paragraphs Carousel bundle. Inspect the running site and tell me how long each slide is set to stay on screen, and which field holds that setting.
evals.expected_output: The bp_carousel paragraph's bp_slide_interval field is set to 6000, i.e. the '6 Seconds' option (bp_slide_interval is a list_string with allowed values false/None and 1000-7000 for 1-7 seconds). It holds two bp_simple slides in bp_slide_content.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Bootstrap Paragraphs module is installed but no content type uses it yet. Add a Paragraphs field named field_bp_task_sections to the Article content type so editors can build page sections with it: it must be an entity_reference_revisions field targeting paragraph entities with unlimited cardinality, it must allow exactly the three bundles bp_simple, bp_image and bp_columns (and no others), and it must appear on Article's default form display using the Paragraphs widget. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A FieldStorageConfig node.field_bp_task_sections of type entity_reference_revisions with settings.target_type=paragraph and cardinality -1, a FieldConfig on bundle article whose settings.handler_settings.target_bundles is exactly {bp_simple, bp_image, bp_columns}, and a component for the field in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default using the entity_reference_paragraphs (or paragraphs) widget.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has an Article node titled 'BP Hard Styled Page' with an empty Paragraphs field field_bp_hard_sections. Using the Bootstrap Paragraphs module, add one Simple (bp_simple) paragraph to that field with some body text and with these styles applied: header text 'Hello Bootstrap', width Narrow, background Brand Primary Color, and margin Top and Bottom Large. Save it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A bp_simple Paragraph referenced from the node's field_bp_hard_sections with bp_header='Hello Bootstrap', bp_text non-empty, and the style fields storing their CLASS values, not labels: bp_width='paragraph--width--narrow', bp_background='paragraph--color paragraph--color--primary', bp_margin='mt-5 mb-5'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is an Article node titled 'BP Hard Uneven Page' with an empty Paragraphs field field_bp_uneven_sections. Using Bootstrap Paragraphs, build a two-column section in that field where the first column is twice as wide as the second: add a Columns (Two Uneven) paragraph set to the '2/3 - 1/3' column style, containing exactly two Simple (bp_simple) child paragraphs, one per column. Save it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A bp_columns_two_uneven Paragraph referenced from field_bp_uneven_sections with bp_column_style_2='paragraph--style--66-33' (the '2/3 - 1/3' allowed value) and bp_column_content_2 holding exactly two bp_simple child paragraphs. bp_column_content_2 has cardinality 2, so no more than two children fit.
